title: Stationary objects over Montana written off as Soviet surveillance
summary: unidentified clip speaker tells of Stationary objects over Montana written off as Soviet surveillance, about unspecified (Cold War) at Montana, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The rumors were they're probably Soviet surveillance planes. Surveillance planes, you know, and the controller told me they were basically stationary. You know, are the Soviets flying helicopters over Montana? I don't think so.

plain: A man named Robert Hastings tells a podcast that a controller once told him about objects seen over Montana that were basically stationary in the sky. Hastings says the rumor at the time was that they were Soviet spy planes, but he doubts the Soviets were flying hovering aircraft over Montana, which would leave the objects unexplained.
